commits.subject: fix(dashboard): flip-day skip visibility — gate the banner on the committed-pick predicate + name the streak-dependent bar
commits.body:
Two fixes from the 2026-07-01 audit (F1), triggered by the first live
projected-pick->real-skip flip:

1. The SKIP banner was suppressed by pick-FILE existence (_has_today_pick),
   but a provisional file (3am preview / projected-lineup save) is not a pick.
   On a flip day the stale undelivered file hid the banner while the dashboard
   hero showed a pick production had declined. Suppression now keys on
   daily_decision.is_scoreable_commit — the #145 shared predicate.
   pick_locked is deliberately not consulted (a classification-lock of an
   undelivered file would re-hide the banner after first pitch).

2. Skip messages said 'below the ~80% bar', but the bar is streak-dependent
   (0.796 at streaks 8-15, 0.8115 at 16-25 under the deployed policy) — today's
   skip of an 81.0% candidate at streak 17 read as a contradiction. New
   strategy.effective_pick_bar (pure, display-only, never feeds the pick path)
   surfaces the applicable bin edge through build_skip_summary into the log
   line, skip DM, and banner at 0.1% precision. Legacy summaries without
   'bar' keep the old wording.

commits.subject: fix(dashboard): skip-day rendering completeness — history SKIP marker, hero/placeholder/live-section yield to the banner
commits.body:
Finishes the flip-day display class (2026-07-01 audit F1; Eric's two reports
2026-07-02):

1. History rows: a result-less pick file whose day finalized as an MDP skip
   (decision.json action=skip) rendered as an eternally-pending pick — no
   scorer will ever fill it (correctly). Now renders a muted SKIP marker.
   Rows with no decision record keep the pending dash (mid-day provisional).
2. A standing skip now owns the day's status: the 'Waiting for lineups'
   placeholder no longer contradicts the SKIP TODAY banner, the hero card
   does not render a stale provisional file as today's pick, and the live
   scorecard section does not fetch a declined candidate's game. A late
   genuine pick clears the banner and restores all three on next refresh.

TDD: 7 new render_page-level tests (38 in file, suite 1534).
